question: Which durable shared contract should represent automatic Codex tool summaries before Slack decides how to present them?
rationale: The choice affects the Plugin SDK/producer boundary and the documented meaning of Slack's existing `toolProgress` preference; a private marker should not silently establish that product contract.

options.title: Reuse shared progress events
options.body: Route Codex summaries through the existing typed progress pipeline and preserve channel-specific configuration at the Slack presentation boundary.

options.title: Add a generic reply intent
options.body: Approve and document a new typed generic ReplyPayload progress intent with compatibility tests for every affected channel.

options.title: Keep current delivery semantics
options.body: Reject unconditional suppression and retain existing standalone progress delivery until a shared contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Reuse shared progress events
recommendation.body: Route Codex summaries through the existing typed progress pipeline and preserve channel-specific configuration at the Slack presentation boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person closest to Slack progress-draft behavior and its shared streaming policy.
